steps.text:
Use `FormControlLabel`’s `labelPlacement="start"` prop:

```jsx
<FormControlLabel
  control={<Switch checked={checked} onChange={handleChange} />}
  label="Enable notifications"
  labelPlacement="start"
/>
```

`start` puts the label before the control (left in LTR layouts), with no RTL styling needed. The supported placements are `start`, `end` (default), `top`, and `bottom`. [FormControlLabel API](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/form-control-label/)
